observation: Validation-first flow caught the AU2 runtime contract in service tests before implementation was considered complete: resolver defaults, overrides, lifecycle states, built-ins, backfill, and boot wiring all have executable coverage.
Splitting AU2 across planner, DB/shared worker, server worker, security/validation worker, boot-wiring worker, and fresh reviewer let independent slices land without write conflicts.
The architecture plan artifact lives under ignored .pipeline/plans, so shipping AU2 requires explicit force-staging of .pipeline/plans/AU2.md rather than normal path staging.
Broad retro lore scans across shared server directories produce thousands of historical matches; AU2-specific retro checks need changed-file filtering including untracked files to stay useful.
